name: NVDA/AMD Pairs Trading Strategy
description: Pairs trading strategy on NVDA vs AMD using price ratio SMA crossover. Computes daily NVDA/AMD price ratio, then applies 20-day vs 50-day SMA crossover on the ratio. When fast SMA crosses above slow SMA, goes long NVDA (50% allocation) and short AMD (50% allocation) for dollar-neutral exposure. Exits when fast SMA crosses below slow SMA. No stop loss — exits only on signal reversal.
source:
# NVDA/AMD Pairs Trading Strategy - Dollar-Neutral SMA Crossover
# Ratio: NVDA close / AMD close
# Signal: 20-day SMA of ratio crosses above 50-day SMA → long NVDA, short AMD
# Exit: 20-day SMA crosses below 50-day SMA → go flat
# Sizing: 50% long NVDA, 50% short AMD (dollar-neutral)

# --- Data ---
# Load both assets explicitly via reference_stocks for consistent ratio computation
nvda_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="NVDA")()
amd_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="AMD")()
nvda_close = nvda_ref.c
amd_close = amd_ref.c

# --- Ratio and SMA signals ---
# Price ratio: NVDA / AMD
ratio = nvda_close / amd_close

# Fast (20-day) and Slow (50-day) SMA of the ratio
ratio_fast = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)
ratio_slow = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)

# Entry: fast SMA crosses above slow SMA (ratio trending up → NVDA outperforming)
entry_signal = crossover(ratio_fast, ratio_slow)
# Exit: fast SMA crosses below slow SMA (ratio trending down → NVDA underperforming)
exit_signal = crossunder(ratio_fast, ratio_slow)

# Persistent state: in trade from entry until exit
in_trade = hold_until()(enter=entry_signal, exit=exit_signal)

# --- Per-asset directional logic ---
# Determine which asset context we're running on
is_nvda = is_asset_ref(ticker="NVDA")()
is_amd = is_asset_ref(ticker="AMD")()

# NVDA: long entry when in trade
# AMD: short entry when in trade
long_entry = is_nvda and in_trade
short_entry = is_amd and in_trade

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Dollar-neutral: 50% of account equity per side
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=50)
